revisions.note: Added the validation and test files (OSF project pq7vb, 'Validation set' and 'Test set' of Track #5 (EEG / ear-EEG ERP detection during walking)) that moabb.datasets.BCIComp2020WalkingERP reads for runs 1 and 2; the original snapshot held only the training file per subject. Stored under the OSF file id, the name the loader caches https://osf.io/download/<id>/ as. Size, MD5 and SHA-256 checked against the OSF API (attributes.extra.hashes).
